I am planting beans on this small plot like I did last year. I do not buy the white fertilizer for beans — beans make their own strength in the soil, and that bag is too costly for me. I will put some goat droppings I gathered from our pen, and use the seeds I kept from last harvest. My daughter and I will do the weeding ourselves.
